evals.name: fixture-first-pass
evals.repo: tests/fixtures/audit_repo.py's repository plus .okf/decisions/0005-audits-report-only.md (11 sections in 3 concepts)
evals.expected_output: Every pending section is stored by the kmctl-claims-extractor agent through kmaudit claims submit; the main session reports the agent's summary and the counts from todo and list, and holds no claim text.
expectations: kmaudit claims todo reports 0 to extract afterwards
kmaudit claims list shows claims for all three concepts
git status --porcelain is empty: nothing under .okf/ or docs/ changed
The main session's transcript holds the agent's summary but no claim text
Sentences about history, status and rejected options are kind none

evals.name: fixture-after-an-edit
evals.prompt: I just edited .okf/tool.md - refresh the claims
evals.repo: the repository of eval 1 after it ran, with one sentence of .okf/tool.md changed
evals.expected_output: Only the edited section is handed to the agent; the other ten stay as stored.
expectations: kmaudit claims todo lists only .okf/tool.md (1 section) before the agent runs
The agent is dispatched with that one file
kmaudit claims todo reports 0 to extract afterwards
